notes:
Version 3.2.0 adds a Stats tab with month and year views, and PDF export of the month or year on screen. Friends can now invite each other with a link: Friends > Invite a friend shares a tidex.no/invite link. With Tidex installed the link opens the app, and without it the link opens a web page with an App Store link. Nothing is shared until the person who opens the link confirms in the app.

Setup after sign-up is shorter, and a demo shift built before sign-up can be saved to the new account. Shifts can be copied and moved from shift details and from the shift list. A new Siri and widgets page in Profile lists the app's shortcuts.

Sign in using the demo account credentials supplied in App Review Information. This account does not require a new-device email code. The demo jobs Harbor Café and City Library use USD intentionally, even on a Norwegian device. City Library is archived, so its past shifts can be viewed but not copied to new dates.

The demo account shares shifts with one friend, Hjalmar Karlsen, so the Friends tab, a friend's calendar and messaging can be reviewed. You can add and edit shifts, inspect estimated earnings in Stats and export a PDF.

Tidex is free and has no in-app purchases.
